summary: Comprehensive testing of AI chatbot and SEO schema fixes completed. All 13 backend API tests passed. All 6 frontend UI tests passed. AI chatbot endpoint POST /api/chat/message works correctly with GPT-4.1-mini via Emergent LLM key - returns relevant responses for F1, football, price questions, and Arabic language. SEO schema fix verified: Event and Product schemas now have proper 'description' and 'image' fields with category-based images (f1-red-lg.webp, football-stadium-lg.webp) instead of logo.png.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat endpoint has good fallback responses when LLM fails - ensures users always get a response
Category-based image mapping in DynamicSEOPage.jsx correctly maps f1->f1-red-lg.webp, football->football-stadium-lg.webp, concert->concert-purple-lg.webp
Chat history stored in MongoDB 'chat_history' collection with session_id for conversation continuity
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI chatbot and SEO schema features fully functional. Key findings: 1) POST /api/chat/message returns 200 with response and session_id for all test cases (hello, F1 questions, Arabic, price questions). 2) Chat widget UI works: toggle button, window open/close, 4 quick question buttons, message sending/receiving. 3) Event schema on /f1-tickets-london-2026 has description (153 chars) and image (f1-red-lg.webp). 4) Product schema has description (154 chars) and image (f1-red-lg.webp). 5) Football page /football-tickets-madrid has image from /images/heroes/football-stadium-lg.webp. 6) All images are category-based, NOT logo.png.
